授業概要
This course provides an introduction to various methodological and theoretical frameworks for examining issues of social diversity and coexistence: theories on nationalism, critical theory, and critical liberalism; theories on toleration and gender theory. The course invites students to think through and recognize the historical contingency of common social conceptions and enables students to analyze critically the operations of social, cultural, and political forces in our contemporary society.
In case you have questions or concerns, please contact us in advance.

授業形態
（内容）
Learning theories and methodologies for examining issues of social diversity and coexistence.
1. Introduction / Sociological approach (6/12 Kezuka)
2. Philosophical approach (6/19 Genka)
3. Sociological approach 2 (6/26 Takahashi)
4. Applied Economics approach (7/3 Kurita)
5. Geographical approach (7/10 Kornatowski)
6. Anthropological approach (7/17 Furukawa)
7. Historical approach (7/24 Hao)
8. Intercultural communication approach (7/31 Li)
The lecture schedule may be subject to change. Please be sure to update yourself with the schedule by regularly visiting the Moodle page.
